invariants: Tables staff, services and appointments exist after createBookingSchema.
At most one active appointment per (staff_id, start_time), enforced by partial unique index appointments_active_slot_unique.

appointments.start_time must already be the canonical UTC form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:00.000Z for a real date on a 30-minute boundary (CHECK constraint), so rephrased duplicate instants are rejected even by direct SQL writes.
services.duration_minutes must be exactly 30 (CHECK constraint); variable-duration services are out of scope for the MVP.
Schema changes are prototype changes with no ALTER migration: existing databases must be recreated from scratch to gain new CHECK constraints.
Cancelled appointments are excluded from the uniqueness index and may be rebooked.
createBookingSchema is idempotent (CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS).
